title: J-CERT+: Certified Full-Catalog Intervention Selection in Signed Graphs

contributions.claim: Assign local response information and current full-catalog coverage distinct validity and maintenance responsibilities, joined by one strict-positive and canonical-selection contract.
contributions.scope: Coverage must be justified for the current operator, opinion, legal domain and threshold. No universal physical-reconstruction lower bound, global edit-set optimality or universal delta=0 completion follows.

contributions.claim: Provide independent implicit access organizations for uniform-weight insertions on all root nonedges and natural-weight flips of negative root edges: H joint row coverage and G flip-first diagonal block coverage.
contributions.scope: H coverage theorem and its O(n+F) frontier-space bound remain H-specific. G has an independent disjoint block-partition argument and no claimed linear worst-case pending-heap bound. Standard rows/heaps/diagonal inequalities are not standalone novelty. General finite catalogs retain D; arbitrary weights/filters need their own coverage mechanism.

contributions.claim: Integrate version transfer, directional intervals, checked equality and supported cost planning under the shared contract, and evaluate complete service costs with explicitly scoped independent checks and completion limits.
contributions.scope: Primary all-root-nonedge requests use fixed dyadic directional maintenance, root reset and empty request Grams; historical adaptive/planner experiments are separate. V4 recorded agreement is not numerical replay. G has lower measured aggregate cost; retaining H/light_v1 is a conservative switching decision, not an H performance-superiority claim.
